dedupe_keys.name: srsran project now ocudu open source 5g ran cu du software

description: The srsRAN Project is a complete open-source 5G radio access network (RAN) with an O-RAN native centralised unit and distributed unit (CU/DU) developed by Software Radio Systems. It implements the full layer 1, 2 and 3 stack with few external dependencies, runs on x86 and ARM, and follows the 3GPP split between the distributed unit and the centralised unit, which is further split into control plane and user plane. Coverage: generic software. Its README says that as of December 2025 development moved to OCUDU, a permissively licensed 5G CU/DU project hosted by the Linux Foundation's OCUDU Ecosystem Foundation, with code on GitLab, and that the GitHub repository will be archived. Format and access: C++ source code and documentation; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): BSD-3-Clause (Open MPI variant) for OCUDU; srsRAN Project AGPL-3.0. Caveats: radio hardware or a simulated radio link is needed; the software was not built or run for this record. Simulation uses: 5G testbeds and digital twins of radio access networks for capacity planning and resilience studies. Related records: Open5GS (platform-open5gs-open-source-5g-lte-core) is a core network it can connect to, and Colosseum (platform-colosseum-open-ran-digital-twin) is an Open RAN emulator.
